subject: Third-party activation: privacy & PO checklist (next steps)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueharbor.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Third-party activation: privacy & PO checklist (next steps)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the integration with Blue Harbor Health. We’re kicking off the supplier activation and need to confirm a few privacy & procurement items so we can create the PO and move to onboarding. Can you please confirm the items below (feel free to reply inline):

1) DPA: will Blue Harbor sign Redwood’s standard DPA as-is, or do you need a redline? If you need internal review, an estimate of timeline is helpful.
2) Subprocessors: please share your current subprocessor list (names, purpose, location, contract dates). A CSV is great.
3) Data retention: what is your standard retention period for customer data and logs that may contain PII? Any auto-purge windows?
4) Certifications: do you have a current SOC 2 report or ISO cert we can reference? If you have a summary link, that works.
5) Billing / PO instructions: legal entity name for invoicing, address, AP contact and invoice email, and any PO number format requirements.
6) Any onboarding forms your procurement team requires (W-9, vendor portal registration, etc.).

I’ve attached our Supplier Onboarding Form and a DPA template to speed the process — filling the onboarding form and returning the subprocessor CSV will let us trigger procurement to issue a PO. If you can send the items by end of week (EOW Fri 8/7) that would keep us on the target timeline for a mid-August start.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf (stub), Redwood_DPA_Template.docx (stub)
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueharbor.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Third-party activation: privacy & PO checklist (next steps)

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers:

• DPA: We will need to review the DPA internally. Blue Harbor generally signs vendor DPAs but the security/legal team will confirm whether any redlines are required. Expect a preliminary answer in 3–5 business days.
• Subprocessors: I’ve attached our current subprocessor list (exported from our vendor registry). It includes contract start/end dates and the service purpose. I will follow up with a version that includes the encryption-at-rest status for each provider.
• Retention: Our standard retention policy for customer PII is 7 years by default, with a 30/90/365-day log retention window depending on log type. I’ll confirm exact classifications.
• Certifications: We publish a SOC 2 summary and control matrix internally; I can share a redacted summary PDF.
• Billing / PO: Please send invoices to accounts-payable@blueharbor.io. If you need a W-9, I can attach it. Our AP prefers PDF invoices with a PO number in the subject line.

Attaching: BlueHarbor_Subprocessors.csv (stub).

I’ll follow up with the SOC 2 summary and W-9 in a separate email.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Vendor Relations Manager
Blue Harbor Health
elena.torres@blueharbor.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueharbor.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Third-party activation: privacy & PO checklist (next steps)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few follow-ups so procurement can proceed:

- Can you include contract effective/end dates and whether each subprocessor processes PHI/PII? That helps with our risk classification.
- For any subprocessor that stores customer data, please indicate if encryption at rest is enabled and where keys are managed (vendor-managed vs customer-managed).
- If you have a redacted SOC 2 or an attestation, that will speed up our internal approval. A link or PDF is fine.
- On the DPA: Redwoods’ standard expectation is mutual indemnities and a 30-day notification for subprocessor changes; if Blue Harbor has required clauses, please flag them now so legal can triage.

Procurement note (internal): we will not generate a PO until onboarding form + W-9 + confirmation of DPA stance are returned. Rishi — I’ll coordinate PO issuance once we have those artifacts; please hold for my go-ahead.

Elena — if you prefer, we can schedule a short 20-min call with legal and security to review the DPA redline windows.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueharbor.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Third-party activation: privacy & PO checklist (next steps)

Hi all —

Following up with the attachments and a couple clarifications.

• Attached: BlueHarbor_Subprocessors_v2.csv (includes PHI/PII column and encryption-at-rest flag), BlueHarbor_W9.pdf, BlueHarbor_SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted).
• DPA: our legal has reviewed Redwood’s DPA template and we consent to sign. They requested one small clarifying clause around data return on termination — we’ll send a proposed redline by EOD Monday 8/10. If that’s acceptable, we expect to countersign within 3–5 business days after the redline is discussed.
• Billing: AP prefers emailed invoices to accounts-payable@blueharbor.io. Legal entity for tax purposes is Blue Harbor Health, Inc.; mailing address for checks (if needed) is on the W-9.

On the timeline: we aim to return the signed W-9 and the subprocessor CSV today, and expect the DPA redline by Mon 8/10. Please let us know if Redwood needs anything else to expedite the PO issuance.
